comparisons.comparison: Both Citigroup and Bank of America disclose credit loss metrics specifically driven by consumer overdraft loans. However, the trends were opposite in the comparable periods: Citigroup reported an increase in its net credit loss rate driven by overdraft loans in Q4 2024, whereas Bank of America reported that net charge-offs for its deposit overdraft balances (which consist primarily of overdrafts) decreased in 2024, primarily due to lower fraud-related losses.
